description: This file contains a class 'TextMeasure' that demonstrates and tests text measurement and font metrics using the PDFsharp library. It includes rendering snippets that measure string sizes, font metrics like ascent and descent, and draw related visual representations in a PDF document.

classes.name: TextMeasure
classes.description: A class derived from Snippet that demonstrates text sizing and font metrics in PDFsharp by rendering various text measurement examples.

methods.name: RenderSnippet
methods.description: Overrides the base method to draw multiple text measurement examples on the provided graphics context.
